entities.summary: Jorun Thørring is a Norwegian writer, born in Tromsø in 1955. She lives in Melhus Municipality, is a specialist in gynaecology, and has her own private practice in Trondheim. She made her literary debut in 2005 with the crime novel Skyggemannen .
